camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeVulList --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --NextToken E17B501887A2D3AA5E8360A6EFA3B000 --ClusterId c88fb10da1168494091db6aafc5dd0000 --StatusList '1,2,3' --Necessity 'asap,later,nntf' --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 12324284232340000 --Lang zh --UseNextToken false --Dealed n --Remark '1.2.XX.XX' --GroupId 9207613 --Name 'oval:com.redhat.rhsa:def:20172836' --Type cve --AttachTypes sca --CurrentPage 1 --AliasName 'RHSA-2019:0230-Important:_polkit_security_update' --TargetType k8s --Ids '282,281,283' --Uuids '1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-0000' --VpcInstanceIds 'ins-1330000,ins-54140000' --RaspDefend 0
description_zh: 根据漏洞类型查询对应漏洞信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-vul-list --lang zh --ids 282,281,283 --remark 1.2.XX.XX --group-id 9207613 --type cve --uuids 1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-0000 --name oval:com.redhat.rhsa:def:20172836 --alias-name RHSA-2019:0230-Important:_polkit_security_update --status-list 1,2,3 --necessity asap,later,nntf --dealed n --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --attach-types sca --target-type k8s --cluster-id c88fb10da1168494091db6aafc5dd0000 --vpc-instance-ids ins-1330000,ins-54140000 --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --use-next-token false --next-token E17B501887A2D3AA5E8360A6EFA3B000 --rasp-defend 0 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVulList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The IDs of vulnerabilities. You can specify up to 50 IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞ID列表，多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多50个
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en: The remarks for the asset affected by the vulnerability. The value can be the private IP address, public IP address, or name of the asset
parameters.help_zh: 要查询漏洞的资产信息，可以设置为资产名称、公网IP或私网IP
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group.

You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to query the IDs of asset groups
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产分组ID。
您可以调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability.
app: application vulnerability that is detected by using web scanner
emg: urgent vulnerability.
sca: application vulnerability that is detected by using software component analysis
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞类型。取值：
cve：Linux软件漏洞
sys：Windows系统漏洞
cms：Web-CMS漏洞
app：应用漏洞（web扫描器）
emg：应急漏洞
sca：应用漏洞（软件成分分析）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The UUIDs of the servers on which you want to query the vulnerabilities. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain the UUIDs
parameters.help_zh:
要查询漏洞的服务器的UUID，多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en: The alias of the vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The name of the vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞别名
parameters.name: alias_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the vulnerability. Separate multiple statuses with commas (,). Valid values:

1: unfixed
2: fix failed
3: rollback failed
4: being fixed
5: being rolled back
6: being verified
7: fixed
8: fixed and to be restarted
9: rolled back
10: ignored
11: rolled back and to be restarted
12: not found
20: expired
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞状态，多个用英文逗号隔开。取值：

1：未修复
2：修复失败
3：回滚失败
4：修复中
5：回滚中
6：验证中
7：修复成功
8：修复成功待重启
9：回滚成功
10：已忽略
11：回滚成功待重启
12：漏洞不存在
20：已失效
parameters.name: status_list

parameters.help_en:
The priority to fix the vulnerability. Separate multiple priorities with commas (,). Valid values:

asap: high
later: medium
nntf: low
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞修复必要性等级。多个等级之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

asap：高
later：中
nntf：低
parameters.name: necessity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the vulnerabilities are fixed. Valid values:

y: yes
n: no
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞是否已修复。取值：

y：已修复
n：未修复
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的漏洞信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条漏洞信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The additional type of the vulnerabilities. You need to specify this parameter when you query application vulnerabilities. Set the value to sca. If you set Type to app, you must specify this parameter.

If you set this parameter to sca, application vulnerabilities and the vulnerabilities that are detected based on software component analysis are queried. If you do not specify this parameter, only application vulnerabilities are queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询应用漏洞时的附加漏洞类型。该参数固定取值为sca。查询应用漏洞（即Type设置为app）时需要设置该参数。
如果该参数设置为sca，可查询应用漏洞（app类型）及软件成分分析（sca类型）漏洞，如果不设置该参数，只查询应用漏洞
parameters.name: attach_types

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset on which the vulnerability is detected. Valid values:

k8s: Kubernetes component.
uuid: server.
containerId: container
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞所在资产类型。取值包括：

k8s：K8s组件

uuid：服务器

containerId：容器
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) in which the vulnerabilities are detected. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询漏洞的VPC实例ID。多个之间ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: vpc_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the IDs
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use NextToken to query the data of vulnerabilities. If you set UseNextToken to true, the value of TotalCount is not returned. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取漏洞列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

true：使用NextToken方式
false：不使用NextToken方式
parameters.name: use_next_token

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 使用NextToken方式下返回的NextToken值。第一次拉取传空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the application protection feature is supported. Valid values:

0: no.

1: yes
parameters.help_zh:
应用防护（RASP）是否支持实时防护该漏洞。取值：

0：不支持
1：支持
parameters.name: rasp_defend
